hints.persona: Name, personality and story. Not sure what to write? Let the AI do it.
hints.body: Age, head ratio, build and skin tone.
hints.hair: Click a style to choose it. Colors, highlights and details are below.
hints.face: Expression, eye shape, brows, eyes (heterochromia too) and facial features.
hints.outfit: Pick a style, then choose colors from the character's palette.
hints.color: The character's own colors, used for outfits and accessories.
hints.gear: Put each piece on or take it off, or draw its design on its own.
hints.style: Turn the knobs to change the feel of the image.
hints.species: Pick a species to apply its features, then fine-tune ears, horns, tail and wings below.

stage.label: Character
stage.changedTitle: The look has changed since this illustration
stage.changedHint: Press "{{button}}" to redraw with the new settings
stage.portraitHint: Click to enlarge. Adjust the look, then press "{{button}}" for a new one
stage.canonHint: No main illustration yet. "{{button}}" follows this image without changing the design
stage.outfitHint: The illustration for this outfit. The main illustration uses "{{main}}".
stage.outfitEmptyHint: Press "Draw this outfit" to keep the face, hair and body from the main illustration and change only the clothes

draw.notePlaceholder: What should this one show? e.g. a cool stance, holding a letter (optional)
draw.notePlaceholderFirst: What feel are you after? e.g. standing in a rainy city (optional)
draw.canon: Following the final design: no design changes, only this drawing's framing and layout
draw.turnaroundNote: Turnaround: front, side and back in one image, split into three automatically once you adopt it
draw.frontNote: Draw the front first. Once you pick one, add the side and back on the canvas one at a time; they line up into a turnaround automatically.
draw.notePlaceholderFront: Anything to watch for? e.g. sleeves long enough to cover the hands (optional)
draw.notePlaceholderOutfit: Anything to watch for in this outfit? e.g. rolled-up sleeves (optional)
draw.canonOutfit: Keeps the final design's face and hair; only the clothes change

gear.addSubtitle: Write down its name and look first. You can draw its design on its own later.
gear.drawTitle: Draw this piece's design on its own
gear.needPortrait: Draw a main illustration first to draw pieces on their own
gear.needPortraitHint: Draw the main illustration first. Then each piece can be drawn on its own, based on it.

drawPart.title: Draw "{{name}}"
drawPart.subtitle: Draw this piece's design on its own, based on the main illustration.
drawPart.notePlaceholder: e.g. make it brass, a little worn at the edges

reference.addSubtitle: Say what to borrow from it. It's included every time you draw.

face.heteroHint: Click an eye above to choose which one to change. Now changing: {{eye}}. Left and right are the character's own: in a front view the right eye is on the viewer's left.

outfit.none: This character has no outfits yet.
outfit.name: Outfit name
outfit.noPalette: No palette yet. Set the character's colors in Palette first, then come back here.

palette.name: Color name
palette.empty: No colors yet. Give the character 4–8 colors of their own to use for outfits and accessories.
palette.importHint: Pick a color under Hair, Face, Body or Species first
palette.fromImageHint: Click an image to pull out its main colors, then click a color to add it.
palette.fromImageFailed: Couldn't read this image. Try another one.
palette.fromImageEmpty: No main illustration or reference images yet. Draw one or add a reference image to pick colors from it.
palette.fromImageNone: Couldn't find distinct colors in this image (it may be mostly background). Try another one.

presetNotes.key: Rich detail, made for promo art

style.referenceEmpty: Add a reference image and say what to borrow from it (lines, colors, materials…)
style.canonOn: Set as final design: draw as this, no design changes
style.canonOff: Unlock: use as a normal reference

persona.name: Name
persona.storyPlaceholder: e.g. A courier who makes deliveries between orbital cities. Calm and true to their word.
persona.askPlaceholder: What should it add? e.g. flesh out the backstory, give them a signature accessory. Leave blank to fill in from the current profile.
persona.askHint: The AI's suggestions are listed first. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
persona.fillRequest: Based on the current profile, "{{profile}}", fill in this character's settings and look.
persona.readCanon: Fill in the look from the final design
persona.readCanonHint: The AI looks at the final design and fills in what it can see: hair, eyes, outfit, colors and more. You see the changes first and nothing changes until you apply them.
persona.readCanonRequest: Fill in the visible appearance from the final design image.

species.colorNote: If unset, ears and tail match the hair

dice.title: Roll the dice: randomize this page (Ctrl+Z to undo)
dice.label: Randomize {{page}}
dice.done: Randomized this page. Not into it? Undo.

wardrobe.label: Wardrobe
wardrobe.scenesHint: Start a new outfit from an occasion. You can change everything later. Outfits started this way keep only hair and body pieces, so the clothes are designed fresh.
wardrobe.deleteMain: This outfit has the main illustration, so it can't be deleted. To delete it, first draw another outfit, then open that illustration in the Gallery and choose "Make it the main illustration".
wardrobe.deletedDrawn: Deleted the "{{name}}" outfit. Its images are still in the Gallery
wardrobe.mainKept: The outfit with the main illustration can't be deleted, so it was put back.
wardrobe.full: You can have up to {{limit}} outfits. Delete one first.
wardrobe.drawAllHint: Autopilot draws them one by one from the main illustration, and Design QA puts the best image of each into the wardrobe. You can stop any time.
wardrobe.drawAllNeedsDirect: Switch the drawing method to "AIDOL draws directly" in Settings to draw them all automatically, or press "Draw this outfit" for each one.
wardrobe.drawAllRunning: Autopilot is running. Try again when it finishes.
